metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (primary) joined with S2 Cloud Probability over a 20 km buffer around Windhoek (-22.560, 17.065). Target dates: 2020-01-29 and 2021-02-07 with ±5-day window; if empty, widen to ±15 days. If still empty or no valid pixels, fallback to Landsat 8 L2. 2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask with cloud probability < 40 plus QA60 bits; for Landsat 8, mask cloud, cirrus, shadow using QA_PIXEL. Compute NDVI and region means. 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero vs null/error: Count total and valid pixels; if collections empty -> C1; if valid pixels = 0 after masking -> C2; if NDVI mean is null/NaN or outside [-1, 1] -> C3. Otherwise compare NDVI2021 > NDVI2020 -> A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line async function eeGet(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.evaluate((v, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(v); }); }); } function s2Joined(start, end, region) { const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const s2c = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end); const joined = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Join.saveFirst('clouds').apply({ primary: s2, secondary: s2c, condition: ee.Filter.equals({leftField: 'system:index', rightField: 'system:index'}) })); return joined; } function maskS2(img) { const cloudsImg = ee.Image(img.get('clouds')); const qa = img.select('QA60'); const qaCloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); const probMask = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If( ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(cloudsImg, null), ee.Image(1), cloudsImg.select('probability').lt(40) )); const mask = qaCloud.and(probMask); return img.updateMask(mask); } function ndviS2(imgMasked) { return imgMasked.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } function landsat8Col(start, end, region) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80)); } function maskScaleL8(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // Dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)); // Cirrus const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return optical.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } function ndviL8(imgMasked) { return imgMasked.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } async function pickImageStatsS2(targetDateStr, region, windowDays) { const target = ee.Date(targetDateStr); const start = target.advance(-windowDays, 'day'); const end = target.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); let col = s2Joined(start, end, region) .map(img => img.set('diffDays', ee.Number(img.date().difference(target, 'day')).abs())) .sort('diffDays'); const size = await eeGet(col.size()); if (!size || size === 0) return {status: 'EMPTY', tried: 'S2', size: 0}; const list = col.toList(10); const n = Math.min(10, size); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const img = ee.Image(list.get(i)); const dateStr = await eeGet(ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd')); const preCountDict = img.select('B8').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const preCount = await eeGet(preCountDict.get('B8')) || 0; const masked = maskS2(img); const ndvi = ndviS2(masked); const validCountDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validCount = await eeGet(validCountDict.get('NDVI')) || 0; if (validCount > 0) { const meanDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNDVI = await eeGet(meanDict.get('NDVI')); if (meanNDVI === null || isNaN(meanNDVI) || meanNDVI < -1.0 || meanNDVI > 1.0) { return {status: 'C3'}; } const cloudPct = preCount > 0 ? (1 - (validCount / preCount)) * 100.0 : null; return { status: 'OK', source: 'S2', dateStr, preCount, validCount, cloudPct, meanNDVI: meanNDVI }; } } return {status: 'NOVALID', tried: 'S2', size}; } async function pickImageStatsL8(targetDateStr, region, windowDays) { const target = ee.Date(targetDateStr); const start = target.advance(-windowDays, 'day'); const end = target.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); let col = landsat8Col(start, end, region) .map(img => img.set('diffDays', ee.Number(img.date().difference(target, 'day')).abs())) .sort('diffDays'); const size = await eeGet(col.size()); if (!size || size === 0) return {status: 'EMPTY', tried: 'L8', size: 0}; const list = col.toList(10); const n = Math.min(10, size); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const img0 = ee.Image(list.get(i)); const dateStr = await eeGet(ee.Date(img0.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd')); const preCountDict = img0.select('SR_B5').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const preCount = await eeGet(preCountDict.get('SR_B5')) || 0; const img = maskScaleL8(img0); const ndvi = ndviL8(img); const validCountDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validCount = await eeGet(validCountDict.get('NDVI')) || 0; if (validCount > 0) { const meanDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNDVI = await eeGet(meanDict.get('NDVI')); if (meanNDVI === null || isNaN(meanNDVI) || meanNDVI < -1.0 || meanNDVI > 1.0) { return {status: 'C3'}; } const cloudPct = preCount > 0 ? (1 - (validCount / preCount)) * 100.0 : null; return { status: 'OK', source: 'L8', dateStr, preCount, validCount, cloudPct, meanNDVI: meanNDVI }; } } return {status: 'NOVALID', tried: 'L8', size}; } async function getStatsForDate(targetDateStr, region) { // Try S2 ±5 days, then ±15, then L8 ±15 let res = await pickImageStatsS2(targetDateStr, region, 5); if (res.status === 'OK' || res.status === 'C3') return res; if (res.status === 'EMPTY' || res.status === 'NOVALID') { let res2 = await pickImageStatsS2(targetDateStr, region, 15); if (res2.status === 'OK' || res2.status === 'C3') return res2; // Fallback to Landsat 8 let res3 = await pickImageStatsL8(targetDateStr, region, 15); if (res3.status === 'OK' || res3.status === 'C3') return res3; if (res2.status === 'EMPTY' && res3.status === 'EMPTY') return {status: 'C1'}; return {status: 'C2'}; // images exist but no valid pixels after masking } return {status: 'D'}; // unexpected } async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.083, -22.560]); const region = windhoek.buffer(20000); // 20 km radius const dateA = '2020-01-29'; const dateB = '2021-02-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing per date const statsA = await getStatsForDate(dateA, region); const statsB = await getStatsForDate(dateB, region); // 3. Handle error cases if (statsA.status === 'C1' || statsB.status === 'C1') { console.log('One or both windows: Empty Collection.'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (statsA.status === 'C2' || statsB.status === 'C2') { console.log('Images exist but 0 valid pixels after masking in at least one window.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (statsA.status === 'C3' || statsB.status === 'C3') { console.log('Computation invalid (null/NaN/out-of-range).'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (statsA.status !== 'OK' || statsB.status !== 'OK') { console.log('Processing failure or API issue.'); console.log('D'); return; } // 4. Print concise evidence (<=20 lines) const lineA = `Ref 2020-01-29 -> Used ${statsA.source} on ${statsA.dateStr}; imgs valid px: ${statsA.validCount}/${statsA.preCount}; cloud%: ${statsA.cloudPct !== null ? statsA.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}; mean NDVI: ${statsA.meanNDVI.toFixed(3)}`; const lineB = `Ref 2021-02-07 -> Used ${statsB.source} on ${statsB.dateStr}; imgs valid px: ${statsB.validCount}/${statsB.preCount}; cloud%: ${statsB.cloudPct !== null ? statsB.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}; mean NDVI: ${statsB.meanNDVI.toFixed(3)}`; const diff = statsB.meanNDVI - statsA.meanNDVI; console.log(lineA); console.log(lineB); console.log(`NDVI Δ (2021-02-07 minus 2020-01-29): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`); // 5. Final Answer if (statsB.meanNDVI > statsA.meanNDVI) { console.log('A: Yes'); } else { console.log('B: No'); } } catch (err) { console.error('Error:', err); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
